title: P ZERO Race 4S
notes: Official tech specs read 2026-11-01: 26-622 226 g, 28-622 252 g, 30-622 278 g; 120 TPI TechBELT. Page: successor of the P ZERO Velo 4S, Pirelli's best-selling all-season tyre; SmartEVO compound enhances performance on wet and cold tarmac; slightly thicker tread for mileage.
